summary: Off Apple platforms, Observation is the Swift toolchain's own module (Isomer builds with Swift 6.3.2), the same open-source code as Apple's. What differs is what is newer in Apple's SDK than the toolchain.

groups.title: Newer than the Swift 6.3.2 toolchain
groups.intent: arrives when Isomer moves to the next Swift release
groups.why: Apple's SDK carries a newer Observation (observation options and tracking tokens, continuous observation) than Swift 6.3.2's.
